bio: This delightful family-run restaurant's enduring popularity among regulars is a testament to the unwavering dedication and passion that have been poured into its operations for the past 40 years. Authentic Italian cuisine is served in a laid-back setting with bags of charm! Staff will be happy to guide you through the options written up on the board and recommend the right wine. Tip: the moderately priced lunch deal. Delicatessen goods can be purchased to take home....
